critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/downloads/release performs a network call to api.github.com per request; consider server-side caching (TTL ~5min) to avoid rate limits under load.
Messages endpoint returns ascending order but uses `before` cursor — confirm index on (channel_id, created_at) exists for pagination performance.
InstallPrompt banner uses `beforeinstallprompt` which is Chrome-only; iOS Safari users will never see it. Consider a manual 'Add to Home Screen' hint for iOS.
